Doc here. I'm typically against all the "marijuana fixes everything" stupidness I come across, but this actually makes sense. Marijuana has estrogen in it (technically phytoestrogen). Take away a breast cancer patients estrogen and you stop tumor regrowth, but many people then suffer bone loss (osteopenia or osteoporsis) because of the lack of estrogen.

So marijuana's estrogen should theoretically do the opposite and help build/maintain bone health. But don't be like one of my patients who took so much "to cure his cancer" that he started growing boobs.

This is my all time favorite pressure cooker recipe! Chicken legs go on sale all time; you can get a dozen for around $4.50 or less. There is something about bone in meat and the pressure cooker that makes wonderful flavors.

Coconut Drumsticks

  • ½ cup flaked coconut
  • 2 tablespoons butter
  • 3 tablespoons tamari or soy sauce
  • 1 teaspoon of fish sauce
  • 1 teaspoon chicken Better Than Bouillon paste or chicken bouillon granules
  • 12 chicken legs
  • ½ cup water
  • ½ cup coconut milk

Toast the coconut in your pressure cooker stirring frequently. Remove the toasted coconut and set aside. Melt butter in pressure cooker, add tamari, fish sauce and Better Than Bouillon, add chicken legs and coat each one with the mixture.

When all legs are coated add ½ cup of water and lock on the lid. Cook for 8 minutes for electric or 6 minutes for stovetop.

Let pressure release naturally. Remove chicken legs and keep warm in the oven.

Heat the liquid left in your pressure cooker and add the coconut milk, reducing mixture by ½ until it thickens. (about 20 minutes) Drizzle thickened sauce over chicken legs and sprinkle with toasted coconut.

I like to spoon a little sauce on my mashed potatoes as well, yum.
